name: evalglass-core
description: An AI quality-control tool for agentic apps. Tell your agent to evaluate your app: EvalGlass discovers your LLM call sites, vendors a stdlib-only runtime into your repo, scaffolds project-specific checks over host-owned gold/rubrics/thresholds, and wires CI on a single Verdict Engine that blocks only after you approve a gate — reporting only what the evidence honestly supports.
